title: Appear2Meaning: A Cross-Cultural Benchmark for Structured Cultural Metadata Inference from Images

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on structured cultural metadata inference (e.g., culture, period, origin, creator) from images across four distinct cultural regions (East Asia, Ancient Mediterranean, Europe, and Americas). The study measures performance disparities across these regions using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework and conducts qualitative error analysis to identify patterns of cross-cultural misattribution and Eurocentric training priors.
